item.tib: mkha' 'gro mdzad drug man ngag las / mkha' 'gro ma sring dam can rnams / mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro 'bum dang bcas / mkha' 'gro'i snying thig gzungs mchog
item.note: the collection of gzungs in this section has a final colophon which says that they were found by rig-'dzin gzha'-tshon snying-po (a name of kun-grol grags-pa) at lho-brag skas-phug, and were then passed on to zhu-g.yas sangs-rgyas rin-chen dpal (in brgyud rim, p. 313, he seems to be referred to as the 'nephew' [dbon] of kun-grol grags-pa).
